claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_numeric spell-attack-only scope
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item separately grants +2 to spell attack rolls and +2 to attack/damage rolls made with the staff itself. The current roll modifier surface cannot narrow to spell attacks only.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding it, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class, saving throws, and spell attack rolls.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: last_charge_partial_property_loss_and_recharge
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The last-charge trigger branches into partial property suppression on a 1 and immediate charge regain on a 20. Existing destruction policies only model destruction or permanent exhaustion.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: On a 1, the staff retains its +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls but loses all other properties. On a 20, the staff regains 1d8 + 2 charges.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DiceAmount.resource_remaining_multiplier
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Retributive Strike damage scales from the number of charges currently in the staff, not charges spent on the activation and not another damage instance.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you take Force damage equal to 16 times the number of charges in the staff

claude_proposed_widenings.name: chance_gate
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Retributive Strike's self-resolution is a probabilistic branch with a 50 percent escape chance. No existing resolution atom models chance-based branching without inventing a save or check.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have a 50 percent chance to instantly travel to a random plane of existence, avoiding the explosion.
